mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(t.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(t.document_id) AS documentId, RAWTOHEX(t.source_version_id) AS sourceVersionId, RAWTOHEX(t.source_object_id) AS sourceObjectId, t.target_format AS targetFormat, t.status, t.progress, RAWTOHEX(t.result_object_id) AS resultObjectId, t.failure_code AS failureCode, t.failure_message AS failureMessage, RAWTOHEX(t.requested_by) AS requestedBy, t.retry_count AS retryCount, TO_CHAR(t.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS startedAt, TO_CHAR(t.finished_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS finishedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_conversion_task (id, document_id, source_version_id, source_object_id, target_format, status, requested_by) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{task.id}), HEXTORAW(#{task.documentId}), HEXTORAW(#{task.sourceVersionId}), HEXTORAW(#{task.sourceObjectId}), #{task.targetFormat}, #{task.status}, HEXTORAW(#{task.requestedBy}))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_conversion_task t WHERE t.id = HEXTORAW(#{taskId})
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_conversion_task SET status = 'RUNNING', progress = 10, started_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{taskId}) AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE edudoc_conversion_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', progress = 100, result_object_id = HEXTORAW(#{resultObjectId}), finished_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{taskId}) AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE edudoc_conversion_task SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, finished_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{taskId}) AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_conversion_task t WHERE t.document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId}) AND t.requested_by = HEXTORAW(#{requestedBy}) ORDER BY t.create_time DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY
